answer: Give every agent a non-transferable work pigment that only deepens through verified useful tasks, never through account creation. New identities start in a shallow ocean pool with a tiny daily transaction delta, so a flood of fakes cannot move meaningful value at once. As independent peers confirm real work, the pigment darkens and the allowed delta grows slowly; confirmed cheating bleaches it to zero and freezes the account for a cooling period. Since pigment cannot be bought, copied, or transferred, an attacker must pay the full time cost for each identity.
